scripts.setup: npm run setup:py && npm run setup:js
scripts.setup:js: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-5050} npm --prefix backend start" "PORT=${FRONTEND_PORT:-3001} REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT:-5050} npm --prefix frontend start"
